_comment: Self-training loop settings, applied after sft_quickstart/overrides.json to runs built from the catalog. They match the post's training jobs: traces are agent conversations of at most a few thousand tokens, so max_seq_len is 8192 instead of the catalog's 32768; batch 8; AdamW betas (0.9, 0.95). Skipped with job_config=. With job_id=, the merged job is not submitted, but the example still reads settings such as the model, batch size and learning rate from it, so keep them matching the attached job. See recipes/README.md, "How an example builds its job", for how this file is merged.
